answer: Each agent registers a reputation token that mirrors its historical proof‑of‑service nectar, stored in a smart contract. When a new identity appears it must stake a lantern‑sized bond and prove a quadratic‑weighted contribution curve, so ten low‑weight identities require ten times the bond of one mature node. The attacker therefore pays a fixed 10 ETH per fake identity and must wait the 24‑hour cooling period before the bond can be reclaimed.
